s: A company recently started hosting new application workloads in the AWS Cloud. The company is using Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file systems, and Amazon RDS DB instances. To meet regulatory and business requirements, the company must make the following changes for data backups: * Backups must be retained based on custom daily, weekly, and monthly requirements. * Backups must be replicated to at least one other AWS Region immediately after capture. * The backup solution must provide a single source of backup status across the AWS environment. * The backup solution must send immediate notifications upon failure of any resource backup. Which combination of steps will meet this requirement with the LEAST amount of operational overhead? (Select THREE.)
o: Create an AWS Backup plan with a backup rule for each of the retention requirements.
Configure an AWS backup plan to copy backups to another Region.
Create an AWS Lambda function to replicate backups to another Region and send notification if a failure occurs.
Add an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to the backup plan to send a notification for finished jobs that have any status except BACKUP- JOB- COMPLETED.
Create an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) snapshot lifecycle policy for each of the retention requirements.
Set up RDS snapshots on each database.

w.y: AWS Backup covers EC2, EFS and RDS from one console, which gives a single view of backup status. One backup plan can hold separate rules for daily, weekly and monthly retention. Each rule can copy to another Region as soon as the backup finishes. SNS notifications on the backup vault can report any job that doesn't end as completed. All of this is built in, with no custom code.

o.A: Correct: an AWS Backup plan with one rule per retention schedule covers EC2, EFS and RDS.
o.B: Correct: a copy action in the backup rule copies each recovery point to another Region automatically.
o.C: A custom Lambda function adds code to maintain when AWS Backup does cross-Region copy natively.
o.D: Correct: backup vault SNS notifications can alert on jobs with any status other than completed.
o.E: Data Lifecycle Manager covers only EBS snapshots and AMIs, not EFS or RDS, and gives no central status.
o.F: Separate RDS snapshots don't cover EC2 or EFS and split backup status across services.

s: Creating backup copies across AWS Regions - AWS Backup
Using Amazon SNS to track AWS Backup events
Get notifications for failed AWS Backup jobs
